info.name: Event Registration & Management API
info.description:
Requests for every endpoint of the Group11 event API (`/api/v1`).

1. Import this collection and `local.postman_environment.json`, select the "Event API – Local" environment.
2. Start the API (`npm run dev`).
3. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Tokens and ids are saved automatically.

Attendees can buy up to 10 tickets per order and place more orders later; each ticket has its own QR code.

Every response uses `{ success, data, meta? }` or `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details } }`. Prices are in kobo.
